findings.title: Change does not address the regression the issue reports; it fixes a different, pre-existing crash
findings.claim: The issue says the analyzer stopped working for SuppressSourceGeneration types in 3.1.1. That regression is commit 1a74a620 ('stop collect field when object marked SuppressSourceGeneration'), which moved the 'if (suppressSourceGeneration is true) return null;' ahead of the member loop. It is on origin/master and the v3.1.x tags, but it is NOT an ancestor of base 32258fdb. In the base, the return is still after the member loop (line 1369), the same as v3.1.0, and suppressed types are already validated: MemberWithoutKeyIsReported, AllowPrivateRequiredIsReported, MemberTypeMustBeMessagePackObjectIsReported and SourceGenerationOnlyDiagnosticsAreNotReportedWhenSuppressed all pass against base source. The change actually fixes the analyzer crash (AD0001) on duplicate or mixed keys. That crash is not specific to suppressed types (DuplicateKeysAreReportedWithoutAnalyzerFailureForGeneratedTypes fails on base too). It also exists in v3.1.0, so it is not the 3.1.1 regression. If this change is merged into the 3.1.x line where users hit the bug, the issue stays unfixed, because the early return still skips all member checks.

evidence.quote: This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.
evidence.note: issue text cannot be verified offline (not counted as evidence)

findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the target branch. For the 3.1.x/master line, revert the effect of 1a74a620 by moving the suppression return after the member loop and AllowPrivate check (as in this base), and keep this crash fix as a separate change.

findings.title: Half of the new tests do not fail without the fix
findings.claim: Run against base TypeCollector.cs, 4 of the 8 new analyzer tests pass: MemberWithoutKey, AllowPrivateRequired, MemberTypeMustBeMessagePackObject and SourceGenerationOnlyDiagnostics. The two new execution tests check run-time behaviour of the dynamic resolver, which the change does not touch. These tests document existing behaviour; they are not regression tests for the change.

findings.title: Generator now silently drops the duplicate/mismatched member instead of failing
findings.claim: For non-suppressed types the generator (reportDiagnostic == null) used to throw on duplicate or mixed keys. Now it skips the offending member and emits a formatter without it. That is safe only while MsgPack005 (Error) is reported by the analyzer. If the analyzer is disabled or MsgPack005 is downgraded via .editorconfig, the build succeeds with a formatter that silently omits a member.

evidence.quote: continue; // The key kind does not match the other members

findings.suggested_fix: When a contract error is found, have GetObjectInfo return null (no formatter) instead of continuing with a partial member set.
